_note: Snapshot of the 150 historical scalp journal trades that used to be read straight out of the live repo-root trading_state.db by test_e2e_backward_compatibility_with_150_journal_trades.  That read made the test depend on shared runtime state: it passed only on a machine whose production database happened to contain this history, and the pytest root-database sandbox (tests/conftest.py::sandbox_root_databases) redirects the connect anyway, so the test saw an empty database.  Seeded from the live database once with sqlite3 ...?immutable=1 (verified byte-identical before and after the read); regenerate only if the historical shape itself changes.
